newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ACCC takes action against orange juice producer.
newsitem.headline: ACCC takes action against orange juice producer.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission said on Tuesday that it had begun proceedings in the Federal Court against Florida Foods Pty Ltd alleging misleading claims on the packaging of two of its products, Florida Fresh Orange Juice and Fresh Premium Orange Juice.
Both products contained the word "unsweetened" on the front of their packages, the ACCC said in a statement.

The ACCC said it alleged that all batches of Florida Fresh Orange Juice and some batches of Fresh Premium Orange Juice contain reconstituted orange juice and preservatives, while some batches of both products contain added sugar.
It also alleged that some batches of Florida Fresh Orange Juice, labelled as "Product of Australia", contain imported orange juice concentrate.
Proceedings had been instituted by the ACCC after investigations in conjunction with the New South Wales Department of Health, it said.
The ACCC is seeking injunctions restraining the company from making the claims, corrective advertising and refunds for consumers who claim to have been misled by the labelling, it said.
